text_block_list.text: (—*clatter bang clatter!*)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ......Phew, that ought to do it. All set.

"—Bright and early in the new year, I had been called out
by Daiwa Scarlet to visit the shrine for Hatsumode."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "At milestones like this, it's important to reaffirm our goals... and our wishes, after all."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"My goal hasn't changed:
it's still 'to become the #1 Umamusume.'"
The "Number One" she aims for—that is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Even though I want to be number one too...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want people to say,
'When you think of Uma Musume, you think of Daiwa Scarlet'……!
"...To achieve that, I must become a 'Number One' who possesses both popularity and true strength."

"Then, from among the Umamusume backed by the people,
a grand stage to crown the strongest of the year—"
choice_data_list: How about we give the "Arima Kinen" a shot?
Shall we try running in the "Arima Kinen"?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Only Umamusume chosen by the fans can run in the Arima, you know!?
You can't just easily—
choice_data_list: Still, you want to be “number one,” don't you?
Still, you want to be “number one,” right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Guh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, then our next move is decided.
I'll enter the races necessary to qualify for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
To build up the track record needed to be chosen.
First at my best distance, then in high-profile races!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Geez, I don't have time to be lingering here.
I need to get back to the academy right away!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So, what are you planning on starting with?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Since you're the one who brought it up,
you must have some sort of idea in mind, right?"
choice_data_list: First, let's get some nutrition here...
Time to rebuild my foundation from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah!?
choice_data_list: You can't fight on an empty stomach.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: We don't have time to waste on that right now...
(Grrr~...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: Let's grab a bite and head home.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Right after we eat, we're training!
Got it?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Back to basics on the very first day of the year, huh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A fresh start, huh.
Well, that might be just what we need right now.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's get right to it!
How about we start with stair dashes right here?

Bursting with motivation for her new goal,
I trained with Daiwa Scarlet starting right from the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's true, relying on just a one-track strategy
is going to make upcoming races tough, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You actually come up with a decent suggestion every once in a while, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "...If you hadn't said that last part, I would've told you how 'dependable' you are."
